comment: Dual C–N bond formation on the core peptide WDW

reactions.description: ShiP catalyzes two C-N bond formation on the core motif WDW

ShiP installs dual C–N linkages (Trp1-C to backbone-N; Trp1-C to Trp3-N) on the core motif WDW of precursor peptide ShiA. The cross-linked mature product Hindustmycin, retains N-terminal arginine residue which undergoes spontaneous cyclization, incorporating a methylene carbon to bridge its amine group to the N of Trp1. ShiA: MTAMLRRIFSTKPSRRWDW
